note: Jehovih as the one who awakens/gives life; spiritual quickening sense, not literal 'speeds up'. Paired with Mover/Creator/Destroyer as divine titles.
Recurring formula asserting that existence/life flows from Jehovih's presence.

ja: 我は「最初」にして「最後」なり
note: Divine self-declaration of encompassing all time; rendered reverently, distinct from biblical Alpha/Omega phrasing.

en: I commanded man to name them
ja: 我は人に命じてこれらに名を付けしめた
note: Recurring creation-and-naming formula in this chapter; Jehovih creates, man names. Keep consistent across verses 1, 4, 8.

en: the seen and the unseen worlds
zh_hant: 可見與不可見的諸世界
zh_hans: 可见与不可见的诸世界
ja: 見ゆる世界と見えざる世界
note: Core cosmological pairing (Corpor vs Es); 'seen/unseen' rendered 可見/不可見 and 見ゆる/見えざる throughout.
Standard rendering for Jehovih's highest worlds; ties to the Etherea/Ethe entries.
'corporeal' consistently rendered 有形 / 有形の, tying man's flesh to Corpor.
The natural whirlwind used as the earthly sign/analogue of the vortex; distinct from the coined term 'vortex' (渦旋/渦). Rendered 旋風/つむじ風 throughout.
'corporeal' consistently rendered 有形 / 有形の, tying created worlds to Corpor; plural companion to the locked 'corporeal body'.
The corporeal, atmospherean and etherean estates bestowed on man; theologically loaded triad summarizing Oahspe's cosmology of man's dwelling.
The mortal, visible man of Corpor; theologically paired with 'spiritual man'. 'corporeal' consistently 有形 / 有形の, tying man to the locked 'corporeal body'.
The unseen, everlasting man within the unseen; theologically paired with 'corporeal man'. Rendered 靈性之人 / 霊なる人 to keep the elevated register.

en: I am the Unity of the whole
note: Climactic divine self-declaration: seen and unseen are all parts of Jehovih's person. Rendered reverently, paralleling the locked 'I am FIRST and LAST'.

The lowest heaven of atmospherea, nearest the earth, where spirits of the lower heaven dwell after mortal death; a recurring cosmological locus. (rendered from 'lower heaven'/'first heaven' occurrences)
The act by which Jehovih's presence animates se'mu into living beings; closely related to 'the QUICKENER' but in verbal/passive form. Theologically loaded and recurring across this chapter.

en: flesh of My flesh and spirit of My spirit
zh_hant: 我之肉中的肉，我之靈中的靈
zh_hans: 我之肉中的肉，我之灵中的灵
ja: 我が肉の肉、我が霊の霊
note: Formulaic theological declaration that all living creatures are part of Jehovih's own being; echoes scriptural register throughout Oahspe.
The moment of intellectual/spiritual awakening when man grasps the physical world and looks beyond it; marks the threshold between beast-man and spirit-seeking man.

en: his spirit had crystallized into separateness
zh_hant: 他的靈魂已結晶而成獨立之體
zh_hans: 他的灵魂已结晶而成独立之体
ja: その霊は結晶して独立の体をなした
note: Theological phrase for the soul's attainment of individual spiritual identity, capable of ascending apart from the corporeal body; loaded spiritual term in Oahspe.

en: the unreal hath become the real
ja: 不実のものは実となりぬ
note: Man's confession that the unseen spiritual realm, once dismissed, is now revealed as the only true reality; counterpart to the locked 'the seen and the unseen worlds'.

zh_hant: 在天上共同承受業業的人
zh_hans: 在天上共同承受业业的人
ja: 天において共同の相続人となるべき者たち
note: Theological phrase for the new race (man) who shares in the etherean inheritance alongside the guardian angels; marks the transition from Asu to the new joint-heir race.
Angels assigned to walk beside and watch over the new race born of the first union; a recurring divine role in Oahspe's cosmology.

zh_hant: 進入我的以太界諸世界的生來權利
zh_hans: 进入我的以太界诸世界的生来权利
ja: 我がエセ界の諸世界への生得の権利
note: The congenital spiritual inheritance granted to mankind through the quickening of the new race's seed; closely tied to 'etherean worlds' and 'quickened into life'.
Recurring designation for Asu, the purely corporeal first humanity, as distinct from the new race (man) born of angel-Asu union. Formulaic in ch. 6.

en: partake of the first fruits of mortality and immortality
ja: 死と不死の初穂にあずかる
note: Formulaic phrase for angels descending to share in the transitional moment between mortal and immortal life; theologically loaded and recurs in describing dan'ha events.

en: etherean hosts of the Most High
ja: 至高者のエセ界の軍勢
note: Formal title for the companies of etherean angels descending during dan'ha; 'the Most High' = Jehovih; recurring reverential formula for these visitations.

en: bound spirits of the lower heaven
note: Angels who, having mingled with mortals and produced offspring, are bound to the lower heaven until they redeem their lineage; a key theological consequence in chapter 7.

en: redeem them in wisdom and power
zh_hant: 在智慧與能力上救贖他們
zh_hans: 在智慧与能力上救赎他们
ja: 知恵と力において彼らを贖う
note: The condition placed on bound angels: elevating their descendants through successive generations before regaining higher-heaven inheritance; theologically loaded.
The organized lower heaven attached to and traveling with the earth; synonymous with 'lower heaven' / 低層天堂 / 低き天 in this context; an Oahspe cosmological institution.

ja: ジェホヴィへの花嫁と花婿
note: Formulaic title for angels prepared in wisdom and strength who ascend to the etherean kingdoms at the end of a dominion; marks them as belonging wholly to Jehovih. Recurring in ch. 7.
Theological term for the cohort of prepared angels who ascend to etherea at a dan; Jehovih names the collective ascension a 'Harvest'. Recurs in ch. 7.
Refers to the higher, free etherean worlds (as opposed to the bound lower heaven); only reachable at the appointed dans. Theologically loaded in ch. 7.
The individual dans (200, 400, 500, 600-year spans) within the larger dan'ha; called 'lesser' because they serve prophecy tables rather than marking full cosmic epochs.
Describes the angels who procreated with the asuans; Jehovih's term for the action by which they produced the new race capable of immortality. Theologically loaded, non-condemning.

en: ascending grade of life / descending grade of life
zh_hant: 上升等第 / 下降等第
zh_hans: 上升等第 / 下降等第
ja: 上昇の段階 / 下降の段階
note: Paired cosmological terms marking the spiritual trajectory of lineages: those who cohabit with their own kind rise, those who cohabit with asuans descend. Recurring moral framework in ch. 7.

The lowest stage of resurrection in the lower heaven, where newly dead spirits are first received and assigned to labor and schooling according to their grade; Oahspe's ordinal for the first step in the ascent of the spirit.

Title given to kings and emperors who are raised to dominion over mortals by Jehovih's God; parallels the title given to God and the Lords as Jehovih's sons, extending the divine family concept into corporeal governance.

ja: エス世界に生まれ出る
note: The transition of a mortal's spirit into the unseen Es realm at death, rendered as a 'birth' into spirit life; mirrors the corporeal birth idiom and marks the beginning of the spirit's heavenly journey.

ja: アシャルたちを追い払う
note: Formulaic phrase for rebellious angels displacing the assigned guardian ashars from their posts over mortals; marks the breakdown of heaven's order. Theologically loaded in ch. 8.

ja: 混沌のうちに霊として生まれ出る
note: Theological phrase for mortals killed in war who enter the es world without preparation, in a state of confusion and disorder; distinct from the normal 'born into the es world' transition. Introduces the consequence of warfare on the spiritual state of newly dead spirits.

en: delivering hells and the spirits in chaos
zh_hant: 解救地獄與混沌中的靈魂
zh_hans: 解救地狱与混沌中的灵魂
ja: 地獄と混沌の中の霊たちを救い回る
note: Recurring description of God's exhausting remedial labor when heavenly order collapses; 'delivering' = rescuing/liberating from spiritual bondage. Theologically loaded as the consequence of angelic rebellion.

en: the roadway of the travel of the great serpent
note: Cosmological phrase for the orbital path of the solar system through the galaxy along which etherean kingdoms are stationed; tied to the 'great serpent' coined term. Recurring cosmological locus for etherean administration.

Paired title for the divine administrators of heavenly kingdoms appointed by Jehovih; recurring formulaic phrase throughout chapters 8 and beyond. Distinct from the singular 'God' who governs the heaven of the earth.
The present cosmic age inaugurated when global civil communion is established and angel ambassadors render up the records of heavenly kingdoms; the culminating age in Oahspe's cosmological timeline.
The formal title for angel emissaries sent to mortals during the kosmon era to render up heavenly records and reveal the history of divine administration; distinct from guardian angels or ashars.
Technical description of Hored as the inaugural organized settlement of heavenly administration; 'organic' in Oahspe's usage means formally structured / institutionally ordered, not biological.

The period before the founding of Hored when earth and her atmospherea lacked formal heavenly organization; the closing phrase of the chapter marking the end of the pre-institutional age. Antonym of 'first organic abiding place'.

Refers to the formally organized, institutionally structured period of heavenly and earthly administration, as opposed to the 'inorganic habitation' that precedes it; theologically marks the founding of heaven's governance on earth.

zh_hant: 上部諸書 / 下部諸書
zh_hans: 上部诸书 / 下部诸书
ja: 上部の諸書 / 下部の諸書
note: Structural classification within Oahspe: Upper Books treat of Etherea and the higher heavens; Lower Books treat of the earth and Atmospherea; recurring organizational formula for describing the corpus.
The core monotheistic doctrine taught by Oahspe's prophets (Zarathustra, Po): the one Great Spirit, i.e. Jehovih. Recurring formula for the essential revelation the prophets re-establish.
Thothma's futile aim: to make the corporeal body incorruptible so it would never die. Theologically loaded as a false pursuit in Oahspe, contrasted with true spiritual immortality.
The animal/earthly self personified as a tempting speaker; distinct from the spiritual self. Rendered 獸/獣 with '自我' apposition matching the source's parenthetical '(self)'.

en: I come not to send peace, but a sword
zh_hant: 我來並非要帶來和平，而是要帶來刀劍
zh_hans: 我来并非要带来和平，而是要带来刀剑
ja: 我は平和をもたらすために来たのではなく、剣をもたらすために来たのである
note: The Beast's inversion of a familiar scriptural declaration—here spoken by 'self' to justify division and war; theologically loaded as the voice of discord in Oahspe.

en: four great heads of the Beast
ja: 獣の四つの大いなる頭
note: The four world religions (Brahmin/Buddhist/Christian/Mohammedan) as the divided dominions of the Beast (self); a recurring symbolic image of institutionalized, enforced religion in Oahspe.

ja: ジェホヴィかく言いたもう
note: The recurring divine-utterance formula introducing Jehovih's direct speech to man; a signature scriptural cadence throughout Oahspe. Rendered reverently in elevated register.

en: carnivorous man of contention to an herbivorous man of peace
zh_hant: 從好爭鬥的食肉之人轉變為愛好和平的食草之人
zh_hans: 从好争斗的食肉之人转变为爱好和平的食草之人
ja: 争いを好む肉食の人から平和を愛する草食の人へ
note: The seventh-era transformation Jehovih commands: from flesh-eating and warlike to plant-eating and peaceful; theologically loaded contrast tying diet, disposition and the end of war.

The mark given to those who refuse Jehovih's covenants (the Uzians); counterpart to the Faithists' covenants. Ties the Uzians to the dominion of the Beast (self). Rendered 那獸的數目 / 獣の数, consistent with the locked 'Beast' entry.

en: in full consciousness, whilst still living on the earth
zh_hant: 在仍活於大地之時，於全然的意識之中
zh_hans: 在仍活于大地之时，于全然的意识之中
ja: なお地上に生きながらにして、全き意識のうちに
note: Oahspe's stated aim: that mortals may hear the Creator's voice and see His heavens while still alive and fully conscious, not merely after death or in trance. A signature promise of the book's purpose.
The military officers of the warring ruler, ironically titled as functionaries of death; part of the confessional 'Voice of Man' lament over the glorification of warfare.

en: In the pretense of enforcing peace I hewed my way in flesh and blood
zh_hant: 在強制施行和平的偽裝之下，我在血肉之中殺出了一條血路
zh_hans: 在强制施行和平的伪装之下，我在血肉之中杀出了一条血路
ja: 平和を強いるという偽りの装いのもとで、我は血と肉のうちに己が道を斬り開いた
note: The confession that war is waged under the false pretext of establishing peace; ties to Oahspe's theme of enforced religion/order as the dominion of the Beast (self). Theologically loaded self-indictment in the 'Voice of Man' lament.

Jehovih's commandment, invoked in the 'Voice of Man' confession where warlike man set patriotism above the divine prohibition against killing. Rendered as a concise imperative commandment in elevated register.

ja: 鬼火のごとく虚しきもの
note: The 'ignis fatuus' (will-o'-the-wisp) image applied to the kingdom man creates for patriotism's sake—an illusory, deceptive light leading men astray. Rendered with the 鬼火/鬼火 (marsh-light) figure to preserve the sense of a delusive, empty thing.

en: war was a necessary evil to prevent a too populous world
zh_hant: 戰爭是防止世界人口過多所必需的惡
zh_hans: 战争是防止世界人口过多所必需的恶
ja: 戦いは世界が人あまりに多くなるを防ぐために必要なる悪である
note: A self-justifying falsehood in the 'Voice of Man' confession—the pretext that war is needed to check overpopulation; theologically loaded as one of warlike man's excuses before Jehovih.

en: a pruning knife in Thy vineyard
zh_hant: 祢葡萄園中的一把修枝刀
zh_hans: 祢葡萄园中的一把修枝刀
ja: 祢の葡萄園における剪定の刃
note: The confessional image of warlike man exalting himself above the Creator's works, presuming to cut down what Jehovih created alive as though pruning the divine vineyard; a self-indictment in the 'Voice of Man' lament.

The great dan'ha cycles of etherean time through which the earth and her heavens pass; recurring organizational term tying the etherean administration to Oahspe's chronology. Rendered consistently with 'etherean worlds'.

en: To Whom none can attain forever
ja: 誰一人としてとこしえに到達しえぬ者
note: Divine attribute closing the litany of the Creator's names: the Creator is infinite, never to be fully reached or comprehended even in eternity. Elevated, reverential register.

Title for angels (archetypally Anuhasaj) who assume kingdoms in atmospherea, deny Jehovih, and profess themselves the Creator though born of woman; the counterfeit of the true divine title, foundational to Oahspe's account of false religion. Rendered 偽主神 / 偽りの主なる神, tying 主神 to the locked 'Lord'.
The formal divine title bestowed on Sethantes at his coronation; Jehovih's commission given through the Orian Chief's emissary. Recurring honorific in the books of God.

en: In Jehovih's name, and in the love of
zh_hant: 以耶霍維之名，並在……的愛之中
zh_hans: 以耶霍维之名，并在……的爱之中
ja: ジェホヴィの名において、……の愛の中において
note: Formulaic greeting used by etherean emissaries when presenting themselves at a coronation; recurring ceremonial opening in the Books of God.

Oahspe's term for the divine self-consciousness within man—the spark of Jehovih's own being that faith nurtures to perfection; the inner wellspring from which man becomes a son of Jehovih. Recurring theological concept throughout Oahspe, referenced in Abracadabra's definition.
